## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address?

## Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed solution in detail. Include:
- How it would work
- User interface changes (if applicable)
- API changes (if applicable)
- Configuration changes (if applicable)

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Impact on Existing Features
Will this feature affect existing functionality? If so, how?

## Documentation Requirements
What documentation would need to be updated or created for this feature?

## Related Documentation
- Links to relevant documentation files (AGENTS.md, policies/, templates/)
- Related inventory items or similar features
